c.title: $4,300 / 3br - 1064ft2 - Beautiful 3 Bedroom + 2 Bathroom Apartment in the Heart of Kitsilano (Vancouver BC)
c.description:
Welcome to this bright and modern 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in one of Vancouver's most desirable neighbourhoods – Kitsilano. Located in a beautiful one-year-old development, this home offers contemporary finishes, an excellent layout, and an incredible outdoor living space.

Features:

Spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout
Large private patio – perfect for relaxing or entertaining (with private storage for 2 bikes at no extra cost)
Modern kitchen with quality appliances and finishes
Bright, open-concept living area
Water included in the rent
Street parking available right in front of the unit on West 12th avenue
Caretaker
Professionally managed by Hunter McLeod Realty Corp.
Well-maintained, secure building
Pets welcome! (half month deposit required)
One- year fixed term - month to month after
Available - December 01 or December 15, 2026
Enjoy everything Kitsilano has to offer, including nearby beaches, parks, shops, cafés, restaurants, and convenient transit, all within walking distance.
